<!-- pr-reviewer: b172d7040ba7fb6df0f2e76cdc9421ed0275a6d0 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The fixture helper reserves each directory with atomic `create_dir`. It skips occupied paths and reports other errors. The save/reopen test reserves its output directory. The change does not alter machining logic, geometry, verification, or posted G-code. No goldens moved.

Local results against upstream/main `4d6b75e775064d665a7716d438757ef2689d90c3`:
- The trial merge was clean. This main commit is already an ancestor of the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. All six `bore_core` tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test bore_core --no-run`: PASS.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Heavy lanes: the dry-run plan reached no heavy test.
- Extra suites run: the two directory-collision checks below. No fixture file or import code changed, so the extra fixture and importer suites do not apply.
- Safety mutations: not required. This change affects test directory setup only. I changed no PR code.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/tests/bore_core.rs:134-147`: Reserve the seed directory before writing to it or deleting it. `create_dir_all` accepts an existing PID path. Line 136 can overwrite an existing file or fail on another user's files. Line 147 can delete existing data. Thus, the new regression test retains the directory reuse fault that this PR fixes. Use atomic creation with a new test tag on collision, or inject a private temporary root. Delete only directories that this test reserved.

I checked this finding through `cargo test` with a local Cargo runner wrapper outside the repository. The wrapper set a private `TMPDIR`. It seeded the test's exact PID path before it executed the test. The PR files stayed unchanged.
- Existing unrelated sentinel file: the test passed, but it deleted the sentinel. Preservation check: FAIL.
- Existing directory named `previous-owner.txt`: the test failed before it checked the fixture helper. Result: 0 passed, 1 failed.

Exact failure:
```text
panicked at crates/app/tests/bore_core.rs:136:57:
seed prior owner's data: Os { code: 21, kind: IsADirectory, message: "Is a directory" }
```

No other blocking finding. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The regression test now reserves its seed directory with atomic `create_dir`. It skips occupied paths using a fresh test tag. It writes and deletes only the directory it reserved.

Pin: `bore_fixtures_preserve_existing_pid_paths_and_isolate_repeated_tags` now checks the preserved marker contents. External collision probes also checked an unrelated sentinel file and an existing `previous-owner.txt` directory. Reverting only the reservation change was RED: it deleted the sentinel and failed with `IsADirectory`. Restoring the fix was GREEN and preserved both collisions.

Validation: `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all six `bore_core` tests. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. The first gate attempt hit incompatible seeded build artifacts; cleaning this worktree and using the supported cache opt-out resolved it. No evidence files were committed.

New head: `3a266281418e3f577e1436cbab476e2d3f520050`.

Please re-review this finding. The PR remains draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3a266281418e3f577e1436cbab476e2d3f520050 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier finding is resolved. The regression test now reserves its seed directory with atomic `create_dir`. It skips occupied paths before it writes or deletes data. The test also checks the preserved marker contents.

The fixture helper reserves separate directories for repeated tags. The save/reopen test reserves its output directory. No machining logic, posted G-code, geometry, collision check, or stock simulation changes. No goldens moved. No UI files changed.

Local results against upstream/main `4d6b75e775064d665a7716d438757ef2689d90c3`:
- Trial merge: clean. This main commit is already an ancestor of the PR head.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. All six `bore_core` tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test bore_core --no-run`: PASS.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Heavy plan: no heavy test selected.

Extra suites run:
- The regression test with an occupied seed path and an unrelated sentinel file: PASS. All existing contents remained unchanged.
- The regression test with an existing `previous-owner.txt` directory: PASS. The directory and unrelated file remained unchanged.
- Both checks also seeded an occupied numbered fixture file and directory. Both remained unchanged.

These checks used `cargo test` with a local Cargo runner wrapper in `/tmp`. The wrapper used a private temporary root. No PR code changed. No evidence files were committed.

Safety mutations: not required. This PR changes test directory setup only. I repeated both earlier collision checks; both are GREEN. No source mutations were made.

No fixture files or importer code changed. The additional fixture and importer suites do not apply.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"). The reviews that this merge relies on: mkinney's `pr-reviewer` marker on head 3a266281 (ready), after his change request on b172d7040 (atomic create_dir); the head moved after that request, and the new marker names it. `cargo xtask merge-plan` puts it in wave 1, with no refresh. `main` is green. I merge it on head 3a2662814. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays.
